=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text hy "-"
text colon ": "
text ones "zero\none\ntwo\nthree\nfour\nfive\nsix\nseven\neight\nnine\nten\neleven\ntwelve\nthirteen\nfourteen\nfifteen\nsixteen\nseventeen\neighteen\nnineteen\n"
text tens "twenty\nthirty\nforty\nfifty\nsixty\nseventy\neighty\nninety\n"
text scales "thousand\nmillion\nbillion\ntrillion\nquadrillion\nquintillion\n"
text hund " hundred"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note word writes element k of a newline-terminated list
fn word t view uchar * k ulong to void
s = ulong 0
m = ulong 0
for i ulong len t
if eq get t i 10
if eq m k
emit part t s sub i s
ret
end
m = add m 1
s = add i 1
end
end
trap 9
end
note three writes 1..999 in words: hundreds, then the rest (under 20 by name, else tens-ones)
fn three g ulong to void
h = div g 100
r = rem g 100
if gt h 0
word ones h
emit hund
if gt r 0
emit sp
end
end
if and gt r 0 lt r 20
word ones r
end
if ge r 20
word tens sub div r 10 2
if gt rem r 10 0
emit hy
word ones rem r 10
end
end
end
note spell splits n into groups of three digits and writes each non-zero one with its scale
fn spell n ulong to void
if eq n 0
word ones 0
ret
end
g = new ulong 7 0
v = n
for i ulong 7
put g i rem v 1000
v = div v 1000
end
first = true
for k ulong 7
i = sub 6 k
x = get g i
if gt x 0
if not first
emit sp
end
three x
if gt i 0
emit sp
word scales sub i 1
end
first = false
end
end
end
fn show n ulong to void
emitu n
emit colon
spell n
emit nl
end
fn main to int
show 0
show 7
show 13
show 21
show 99
show 100
show 101
show 999
show 1000
show 1001
show 12345
show 1000000
show 1234567890
show 18446744073709551615
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
0: zero
7: seven
13: thirteen
21: twenty-one
99: ninety-nine
100: one hundred
101: one hundred one
999: nine hundred ninety-nine
1000: one thousand
1001: one thousand one
12345: twelve thousand three hundred forty-five
1000000: one million
1234567890: one billion two hundred thirty-four million five hundred sixty-seven thousand eight hundred ninety
18446744073709551615: eighteen quintillion four hundred forty-six quadrillion seven hundred forty-four trillion seventy-three billion seven hundred nine million five hundred fifty-one thousand six hundred fifteen
</pre>
